info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Bank Portfolio Administration API
info.description: The Bank Portfolio Administration API provides tools for managing and overseeing banking portfolios, allowing financial institutions to perform detailed analysis and decision-making regarding their assets. This API enables users to retrieve comprehensive data about various banking portfolios, facilitating efficient financial management. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts and banking professionals who need to evaluate portfolio performance and optimize asset allocation. By leveraging this API, institutions can enhance their portfolio strategies and achieve better financial outcomes.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access information pertaining to bank portfolio administration, providing valuable insights into financial management within the treasury.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information related to bank portfolio administration in the treasury system. It allows clients to specify parameters needed to filter or modify the data being requested.

200.description: Request completed successfully, the bank portfolio data retrieved.
